recipes.name: One-pan salmon with burst cherry tomatoes, olives and capers

steps.name: Prep
steps.text: Slice the garlic and halve the lemon.

steps.name: Sear the salmon
steps.text: Heat the oil and sear the salmon skin side down for 4 minutes.

steps.name: Burst the tomatoes
steps.text: Turn the salmon, add the tomatoes, garlic, olives, capers and oregano, cover and cook for 4 minutes until the tomatoes burst and the salmon is just cooked. Microwave one rice pouch at the same time.

steps.name: Finish and plate
steps.text: Squeeze over the lemon, set half aside for tomorrow and plate up. Pierre-Guy: 380g salmon and tomatoes, 150g rice. Mariska: 255g, 100g rice.

recipes.note: Rebuilt from the plan log: the dish and timing are as approved, the method and figures are reconstructed estimates.
recipes.storage: Cool within 1 hour and refrigerate. Reheat gently, covered, in a pan for 4 to 5 min until piping hot, or eat the fish cold. Microwave the second rice pouch fresh.

recipes.name: Espinacas con garbanzos

steps.name: Drain the chickpeas
steps.text: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.

steps.name: Prep
steps.text: Wash the spinach and slice the garlic.

steps.name: Toast the almonds
steps.text: Toast the almonds in the oil for 2 minutes until golden, then lift them out.

steps.name: Spice the garlic
steps.text: Fry the garlic with the paprika and cumin for 1 minute.

steps.name: Simmer
steps.text: Add the chickpeas and tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes, lightly crushing a few chickpeas.

steps.name: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Stir in the spinach until it wilts, then add the sherry vinegar and season.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Plate with the yoghurt and almonds. Pierre-Guy: 420g, 120g yoghurt, 12g almonds. Mariska: 280g, 80g yoghurt, 8g almonds.

recipes.note: Rebuilt from the plan log: the dish and timing are as approved, the method and figures are reconstructed estimates.
recipes.storage: Cool within 1 hour and refrigerate. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot. Keep the yoghurt and almonds separate and add them after reheating.

recipes.name: Lemon-oregano halloumi with blistered peppers and mint yoghurt

steps.name: Slice the veg
steps.text: Slice the peppers into strips and cut the onions into wedges.

steps.name: Blister the veg
steps.text: Fry the peppers and onions in the oil over a high heat for 5 minutes. While they cook, chop the mint and stir it into the yoghurt.

steps.name: Fry the halloumi
steps.text: Push the veg to the side, slice the halloumi and fry it for 2 minutes a side. Microwave one rice pouch at the same time.

steps.name: Finish and plate
steps.text: Squeeze over the lemon, scatter with oregano and seeds, and plate. Pierre-Guy: 340g, 150g rice, 60g mint yoghurt. Mariska: 230g, 100g rice, 40g yoghurt.

recipes.note: Rebuilt from the plan log: the dish and timing are as approved, the method and figures are reconstructed estimates.
recipes.storage: Cool within 1 hour and refrigerate. Reheat in a pan for 3 to 4 min until piping hot, keep the mint yoghurt cold, and microwave the second rice pouch fresh.

recipes.name: 5-minute lentil box with feta and mint
ingredients: Dressing: 1½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

steps.name: Dice the cucumber
steps.text: Dice the cucumbers.

steps.name: Tear the mint
steps.text: Tear the mint leaves.

steps.name: Dressing
steps.text: Whisk the dressing and divide it into 4 pots.

steps.name: Box up
steps.text: Divide the lentils, cucumber, crumbled feta, mint and seeds into 4 boxes. Pierre-Guy: 380g and 25g dressing. Mariska: 255g and 15g dressing.

recipes.name: Niçoise with tuna and eggs
ingredients: Dressing: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

steps.name: Kettle and potatoes
steps.text: Put the kettle on, then wash and halve the potatoes.

steps.name: Boil
steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes, adding the eggs after 3 minutes and the beans for the last 4 minutes. While they cook, trim the beans before they go in, slice the radishes, shred the gem and whisk the dressing.

steps.name: Cool
steps.text: Drain, then cool everything in cold water for 4 minutes.

steps.name: Peel the eggs
steps.text: Peel and halve the eggs.

steps.name: Box up
steps.text: Drain the tuna and divide everything into 4 boxes. Pierre-Guy: 450g with 4 egg halves and 30g dressing. Mariska: 300g with 2 egg halves and 20g dressing.

recipes.note: Rebuilt from the plan log: the dish and timing are as approved, the method and figures are reconstructed estimates.
recipes.packing: Dressing in its own pot, with the gem on top.
recipes.flag: Egg recipe: adjust breakfast on these days. Uses the fish allowance. Time is over 30 min.

recipes.name: Levantine lentil salad with pomegranate and tahini yoghurt
ingredients: Dressing: a pinch of salt and a splash of water

steps.name: Drain the lentils
steps.text: Drain and rinse the lentils.

steps.name: Dice the cucumber
steps.text: Dice the cucumbers.

steps.name: Spring onions
steps.text: Slice the spring onions.

steps.name: Herbs
steps.text: Chop the parsley and mint.

steps.name: Pomegranate
steps.text: Halve the pomegranate and knock out the seeds.

steps.name: Dressing
steps.text: Grate the garlic and whisk the dressing.

steps.name: Pistachios
steps.text: Roughly chop the pistachios.

steps.name: Box up
steps.text: Divide everything into 4 boxes, with the dressing in pots. Pierre-Guy: 380g and 40g dressing. Mariska: 255g and 25g dressing.
